title: Iridium
description: Agent-native LinkedIn access. An MCP server giving any agent live profile and post data plus real actions — comments, DMs, connection requests, scheduled posts. 50+ tools across prospecting, inbox triage, commenting, and content, with user approval required before anything sends, server-side rate limits, and a full activity log. Built and shipped end to end.

title: Iridium Agent
description: Open-source chat agent that drives Iridium over MCP. Two states driven by the live connection: unauthenticated it can only describe the toolset and hand back a signup link, never pretending to act; once the server reports ready, every live tool flows in automatically. That state machine is the architecture.

title: vLLM on EKS
description: Fully observable, multi-tenant, scalable inference deployment of vLLM on EKS. Per-tenant isolation with GPU scheduling and metrics wired end to end.

title: Linkedin Agent
description: Agent which will find possible connections and send them cold connection requests. I enjoy building connections in the terminal!

title: Skim Research Papers Agent
description: RAG Agent which helps summarize 100+ page research papers. Built with AWS CICD in mind.

title: Multi Tenant Kubernetes
description: Kubernetes hosting system which allows each user a private secure namespace, serve a common product and host private data within namespaces.

title: Terminal Tweet
description: Tweet from the Terminal, create a server or just tweet with the CLI

title: The Progress App
